song_craft: Voice: stotra couplets, one work-voice across fifteen rasa-colors (adbhuta→vīra→śṛṅgāra→ānanda→śānta — the work walks the rasas home to peace). Each verse hammer-tight in L3: L4 = L3 verbatim throughout, music named per verse. Arc: all-containing light (v1) → aloneness (v2) → inseparables (v3) → mirror-bearing (v4) → exact fullness (v5) → play at once (v6) → five-in-one (v7) → criterion (v8) → abiding change (v9) → total inventory (v10) → bondage named (v11) → open doors (v12) → release (v13) → non-difference (v14) → dwelling enjoined (v15).

lines: His alone is the goddess supreme, hungry to grasp His nature;
fullness in all beings — never little, never more.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tasyaivaiṣā parā devī svarūpāmarśanotsukā | pūrṇatvaṃ sarvabhaveṣu yasyā nālpaṃ na cādhikam

verses.craft: Exactness sounded not stated (never-little-never-more); grasp-eager bounded per UNC.
verses.rejected: (a) exact-fullness abstraction → killed: exactness must sound. (b) hungry→eager soften → killed: utsukā appetite is the verse.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa śṛṅgāra of bounded hunger / L2+L3 voice
